method: Every one of 141 original PNG files was opened with view_image and visually examined individually, not inferred from contact sheets, bounding boxes or automatic checks. Inspected card/detail/wheel for clipping, recognizability, orientation, visible surface artifacts and alpha. Correct alpha composites supplement originals where raw transparent-RGB display was misleading.

limits: Presentation only, not model static QA redo, physical GPU, target-scene or scientific approval
Gallery originals contain low-alpha shadow RGB variation; do not treat raw transparency viewer fringes as visible site artifacts without correct compositing
44 bounded presentation passes, two presentation holds and one pending diagnostic; no final release subset/package frozen.
Static model QA is inherited unchanged; no re-QA or source modification.
A PNG review does not prove animation flicker absence, hardware GPU acceptance, target-scene acceptance, final metadata binding, full CI or deployment.
No final release package was assembled; future base must include actual PR42 merge.
